subject: Restart ignition: stalled POC setup — quick priority check & offered help
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@tidewave.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@acme-solutions.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps & checklist

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC moving: 

- Success criteria (what we agreed): evaluate latency at 99th percentile for 2k-token requests, validate end-to-end privacy controls for user data, and measure per-token cost improvements vs current infra.
- Integration approach: lightweight SDK + S3-proxied artifacts. Diego will own the initial infra connect; Kimberly will support eval metrics.
- Required from TideWave: (1) a sandbox dataset or representative sample, (2) a test user account for API whitelisting, (3) confirmation of any IP/procurement constraints.

Target timeline: onboarding + baseline run in the week of Nov 8, follow-up review Nov 15. If procurement is slower, we can do a limited remote test with obfuscated data. Attached: POC-checklist.xlsx (one-page checklist) and a draft SOW for reference.

Next actions:
1) Elena — can you share the test account and a sample dataset by EOD Nov 5?
2) Samir — if procurement needs to be looped, please introduce the procurement contact so we can surface the SOW items.
3) Internal: Diego / Kimberly — I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff once access is received.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing if priorities shift.

Best,
Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attach: POC-checklist.xlsx, tidewave-sow-draft.pdf

From: Elena Morales <elena@tidewave.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@acme-solutions.com>
Cc: procurement@tidewave.ai
Date: 2026-11-03T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps & checklist

Thanks Logan — appreciated the notes. I’m confirming internally: Samir will take the lead on the test account and procurement will review the SOW. I expect to have the test credentials ready by early next week but procurement may push the kickoff a week depending on docs. Samir — looping you to confirm.

Elena
Head of Data & ML, TideWave

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: TideWave POC — low activity, plan to nudge

Diego / Kim — quick internal note: we haven’t seen access or any usage in the trial cluster yet. Elena indicated procurement might delay but there’s been radio silence since Nov 3. My plan: send a short, helpful bump on Nov 16 that offers a smaller "proof-of-motion" we can run without processed data (obfuscated sample), plus calendar options. If no response after that, I’ll escalate to a short exec touch with a CTO-level note offering a complimentary performance baseline run. Thoughts?

Also attaching a trimmed checklist we can share with procurement to speed sign-off.

— Logan

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@tidewave.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@acme-solutions.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Quick priority check — can we resume the TideWave POC?

Hi Elena / Samir — following up on the POC kickoff. We haven’t received the test account or seen any trial activity and I wanted to check whether the project is still a priority for you this quarter. Two quick options to make this easier:

1) Quick-start with obfuscated sample (no sensitive data) — we can run a baseline in 48 hours and share a short report.
2) If procurement is the blocker, I can share a condensed SOW and a checklist tailored for procurement to speed review.

If either helps, I’m free for a 15-min sync on Mon/Tue (Nov 29/30) — or tell me the right owner and I’ll coordinate. If priorities changed, say the word and we’ll pause the POC and re-open when it’s timely.
